title: Grid with coupons
statement:
You are on a grid of R rows and C columns. Every cell holds a digit from 1 to 9: the price of entering that cell. You start in the top-left cell (you do not pay for it) and must reach the bottom-right cell, moving one step at a time up, down, left or right, never leaving the grid. You may revisit cells, paying again each time. You also hold K coupons: entering a cell with a coupon makes that entry free. Each coupon can be used once. Print the minimum total price to reach the bottom-right cell.

Input: the first line holds R, C and K. Each of the next R lines holds C digits with no spaces.
Output: one integer, the minimum total price.

Constraints: 1 <= R, C <= 500, 0 <= K <= 10. With R = C = 1 the answer is 0.

Example:
Input:
3 3 1
199
919
991
Output:
11
Every route enters at least two cells holding 9. One best route: right (coupon on the 9), down (1), down (9), right (1), for 0 + 1 + 9 + 1 = 11.
